item.title: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
Author, per the Draft Forum's new policy: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-10629348/new-draft-forum-policies authors who have not yet posted a successful mainsite article are now required to get their basic concept(s) greenlighted by two experienced reviewers in the Ideas Critique forum and/or IRC chatrooms before asking for draft feedback.

You currently have an ideas thread for this here: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13909064/my-scp-idea, so please don't make a new thread for it. Instead, check out this thread to see how you can get more eyes on it so you can obtain the prerequisite greenlights: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews.

For clarity: if a reviewer is greenlighting you, they will explicitly say so; neither of the two people who have responded to your thread so far have.
